changelog:
- Initial release of the Context Engineering Review skill.
- Audits LLM context windows to identify bloating, omissions, and contradictions in assembled prompts.
- Produces a context inventory with keep/cut/restructure verdicts, ordering and caching recommendations, and a token budget per component.
- Guides users through analyzing real (or template) context assemblies to improve instruction following, reduce cost, and fix inconsistency issues.
- Includes checklists for quality, anti-patterns, and required validation steps after recommended changes.
